newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan's CPC says rain worsens oil leak.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan's CPC says rain worsens oil leak.

text.p: Taiwan's Chinese Petroleum Corp said on Thursday that it had repaired a ruptured fuel oil pipeline near its northern refinery but said heavy rain was spreading some spilled oil into the surrounding area.
"Rain in the Taoyuan area is washing the leaked oil into nearby farms and roads," an official of the state oil monopoly told Reuters by telephone.
The affected area totalled about 10 ha (25 acres), he said.
Chinese Petroleum reported the incident earlier on Thursday, saying a fuel oil pipeline had ruptured near the Taoyuan refinery but that the problem was under control.
"A small fuel oil pipe had some leakage on Thursday during our pumping process," said company official Liao Pai-fung.
There was no immediate estimate of how much fuel oil leaked before engineers closed the pipeline and stopped the leak.
Chinese Petroleum expected to replace the pipe soon and resume the pipeline's function, Liao said.
The Taoyuan refinery's operations remained unaffected.
